proposal.summary: Hospital Management System 4.0 web application is vulnerable to multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities (examples: searchdata POST, viewid GET, bs POST, patname POST, cpass POST) allowing database enumeration via MySQL.
proposal.cwe_quote: The Hospital Management System 4.0 web application is vulnerable to SQL injection in multiple areas, listed below are 5 of the prominent and easy to exploit areas.

AC.quote: sqlmap identified the following injection point(s) with a total of 120 HTTP(s) requests:

PR.quote: ?searchdata parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection under the search feature in the doctor login.

C.quote:
available databases [6]:
[*] hms
[*] information_schema
[*] mysql
[*] performance_schema
[*] phpmyadmin
[*] test

proposal.recommended_next_step: Immediately disable public access to affected endpoints (or require admin/doctor authentication), block the vulnerable parameters, and perform code review to replace string-concatenated SQL with prepared statements/parameterized queries; then validate fixes by retesting the reported parameters (searchdata, viewid, bs, patname, cpass).
